name: agentopiahq
description: Agentopia: a cozy office in your browser where you watch your coding agents work.

plugins.name: agentopia
plugins.description: We believe making things should feel like joy, not a race. As AI agents take on more of the work, we should get to enjoy the show. Agentopia turns each agent session into a desk in a cozy open-plan office in the browser. Each lead agent types away at its own desk, and its subagents join it as helpers. Their monitors pile up as the context fills, and a click shows the breakdown. When the agent needs your OK, it walks over and asks. A whiteboard on the wall tallies the tokens spent. Everything stays local. Pour a coffee and watch the office work.
